title: Normalization transport for endpoint scalar identity
statement: For a ring stage identity coefficient change, the normalization equation of a ScalarIdentity certificate transfers from an equal-universe coefficient field Ψ to Ω after universe reindexing by scalarAtClosure and any chosen identity isomorphism for its functor.

proof.text: Transport the inclusion map, equality isomorphism induced by h, and multiplication tensor unitor through the finite and integral category presentations; use the normalized equation I.normalized at the corresponding object.

mathlib_searches.query: universe transport of ScalarIdentity.normalized for ring-stage scalar extension
mathlib_searches.results: No direct declaration; this is specific to recorded ring-stage categories.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarIdentityNormalizationAtClosure
    (Ψ : Type (max u v)) [Field Ψ] [Algebra (Padic l) Ψ] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ψ]
    (W : Scheme.{max u v}) {s : RingStage.{max u v} l}
    {a : PurCompactSupport.Change (s.coefficients l) (s.coefficients l)}
    (h : ∀ T : Scheme.{max u v}, a.map T = 𝟙 _)
    (S : Scalar.{max u v, max u v} l Ψ a W)
    (I : ScalarIdentity.{max u v, max u v} l Ψ h W S)
    (J : (scalarAtClosure.{u, v} l Ω Ψ W S).functor ≅
      𝟭 (C.{u, v} l Ω W (s.stage l)))
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω W (s.stage l)) :
    (RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω W s).map (J.hom.app K) =
      (scalarAtClosure.{u, v} l Ω Ψ W S).realization.hom.app K ≫
        (eqToIso (congrArg pbcDerivedExtend (h W))).hom.app
          ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω W s).obj K) ≫
        (PurCompactSupport.tensorIdentity ((s.coefficients l).ring W)).hom.app
          ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω W s).obj K)
